plain: A Tabs, Tag or SegmentedControl text label now sits in a span.hds-selected-width that holds its semibold width, so a test that reads a Tag pill's classes through getByText should use closest().

steps.plain: Each text segment label is now wrapped in a span.hds-selected-width with data-text, so a selector or test that expects the label as the segment's direct text needs one more level.
Each text TabsTrigger label is now wrapped in a span.hds-selected-width with data-text, so a selector or test that expects the trigger's direct text needs one more level.
A text Tag label is now wrapped in a span.hds-selected-width, so a test that reads the pill's classes through getByText should use closest() to reach the pill.
